\section*{Problem Sheet 2: Energy}

\begin{enumerate}

\item A spring of stiffness $k$ is compressed by $x$. Find the energy stored
  in it.

\item A block slides down a rough slope of angle $\theta$. Find the work done
  against friction over a distance $d$.

\item Show that the kinetic energy of a rolling hoop is twice its
  translational kinetic energy alone.

\end{enumerate}
